scenes.question: What's a common notebook mistake?
scenes.wrong: Leaving messy outputs and unclear code.
scenes.right: Not restarting and running all cells before sharing. Always do this for reproducibility.
scenes.say: Interviewers notice if you forget to restart and run all cells. Messy outputs or unclear code can cost you.
